scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p app/tsconfig.json && tsc -p app/test/tsconfig.json && tsc -p app/scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc -p app/e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run test && bun run verify:vectors
scripts.check:firmware:lockstep: cd firmware && cmake --preset host-debug && cmake --build --preset host-debug && ctest --preset host-debug -L lockstep
scripts.check:firmware:gcc: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/src:ro gcc:15 bash -c 'apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq cmake ninja-build && mkdir -p /work/packages/protocol && cp -r /src/firmware /work/ && cp -r /src/packages/protocol/vectors /work/packages/protocol/ && rm -rf /work/firmware/build && cd /work/firmware && cmake --workflow --preset host-release && cmake --workflow --preset host-debug'
scripts.format:firmware:check: find firmware/core firmware/platform firmware/roles firmware/tests -name '*.[ch]pp' | xargs clang-format --dry-run --Werror
scripts.format:firmware: find firmware/core firmware/platform firmware/roles firmware/tests -name '*.[ch]pp' | xargs clang-format -i
scripts.check:all: bun run check && bun run check:firmware
scripts.app:export: cd app && CI=1 EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 bun run export:web
scripts.app:e2e: bun run app:export && cd app && node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts
